missing_claims.claim: A single fixed spatial-barcode or UMI species
missing_claims.evidence: Guide defines N16 spatial barcode and N12 UMI patterns; barcode varies by slide spot and UMI by molecule.

missing_claims.claim: A fixed Dual Index TT sample index pair
missing_claims.evidence: The official TT Set A JSON publishes all 96 well-specific i7/i5 pairs; the Rev F guide specifies the kit but not the well selected in a particular experiment. This is run-specific, not an undisclosed kit sequence.

conclusion: The official Rev F guide establishes the Visium construct. Two independent readers verified the original 10x TT Set A JSON with all 96 i7/i5 pairs; a chosen well remains experiment-specific. Official Space Ranger docs locate the 4,992-spot inclusion list and per-slide layout, but the actual bundle files and a run serial remain uninspected. No absence is accepted.
